repository.name: angular-instantsearch
repository.description: ⚡️Lightning-fast search for Angular apps, by Algolia

issue.body:
**Angular v6 introduces a schema to follow in order to build an distribute libraries.**

Since this is a hard task to always keep up to date I'm switching to [ng-packagr](https://github.com/dherges/ng-packagr) which is handling this task for us.

Warning, this is introducing breaking changes because we are not supporting Angular v4 anymore, this might be a no go but Angular v5 and v6 are now the way to go.

issue.title: fix(platform-server): provide Domino DOM types globally

labels.name: action: merge
labels.description: The PR is ready for merge by the caretaker

labels.name: target: major
labels.description: This PR is targeted for the next major release

issue.body:
Fixes #23280, #23133.

This fix lets code access DOM types like Node, HTMLElement in the code. These are invariant across requests and the corresponding classes from Domino can be safely provided during platform initialization.

This is needed for the current sanitizer to work properly on platform-server. Also allows HTML types in injection - Ex. `@inject(DOCUMENT) doc: Document`.
